name: bungalow
definition: a single-storey house, detached, semi-detached or terraced, sold as a bungalow.
notes: Rightmove keeps Bungalow as its own property type, not included in Detached, Semi-detached or Terraced searches; retirementvillages.co.uk has a Bungalow type filter.

name: fishery
definition: a lake or group of lakes held and sold as a fishing business or fishing venue, often with lodges, tackle shop or cafe.
notes: LandSale has a dedicated Fisheries for Sale category (coarse, trout, multi-lake, with holiday lodges), separate from its Fishing Lakes and Lake pages.
